name: Held By Human
description: An account in some system belongs to this person: an Okta user, a Duo user, a Teleport user or a GitLab user is held by one human. The source is WILDCARD (omitted), like TRUSTS_ISSUER, so any vendor's account type can point here without identity_core depending upward on the vendor plugin. The edge is an assertion that two records are the same person; it is drawn by whoever knows that (an operator's seed, an HR feed, a collector matching an immutable identifier) and never inferred from a shared display name or email address. An account held by nobody has no edge; that is the unmatched state an access review must show, not an error.

matched_on.description: How the account was tied to the person, in one phrase (for example "operator seed", "HR employee id", "Okta immutable id"). Blank means not recorded, not unmatched.
